Purpose of the project
Labeling target
Labeling detail

This project highlights the importance of protecting personal information. Please ensure that the data in this project remains confidential.
Any data copied or exposed will be tracked.
A project to detect and encrypt personal information in CCTV footage, such as human faces and vehicle license plates.
■ Create bounding box on the one’s head in the image

The human face is a bounding box labeling target, and the ears are labeling targets.
The back of a person's head is not a labeling target.​
Even if a person's face is not identifiable or is very small, they should still be considered as labeling targets.
■ Create bounding box on the ‘car license plate’

Create a bounding box to include both letters and numbers on a license plate.
Label plates even if both letters and numbers are not visible; if the boundaries of the plate are visible, label regardless.
Motorcycle plates are labeling targets.

The labeling target is only the face; the hair is not the labeling target.
Masks and glasses on the face are labeling targets.
Earplugs, scarves, bags, umbrellas, helmets, hats, and handheld accessories are not labeling targets.
If earplugs or a cell phone are in the face range, this part should be labeled by guessing the face range.
The back of the person is not a labeling target. (Please note that it is a face labeling project)
Faces reflected in glass, a mirror, or an elevator wall are labeling targets.
When labeling the side faces, include the ears.
(o)The helmet is not the labeling target.
(o)When labeling the side faces, please label the ears.
(o)A person's face is not identifiable or very small is the labeling target.
(o)A person's face on the placards is the labeling target.
If the bounding boxes exist on the head that is not a labeling target(back of head, top of head without face),so do not label them.
If there is no person in the image, please select the “skip” button without labeling.
Create a bounding box around the entire car license plate. (numbers, letters)
Please ensure that the license plate is included correctly within the bounding box.
If a car's license plate is obscured, please estimate the original range and label it accordingly.
Motorbike license plates are all labeling targets.
